preconditions: At least two source-linked reports refer to the same elevation quantity and vertical datum
Each report declares its displayed numeric resolution
exclusions: Reporting resolution is not measurement accuracy
Repeated publication of one survey is not independent measurement replication
The envelope never authorizes lithologic geometry
validationMethod: Positive, conflict, malformed-hash and invalid-depth unit tests
reopenCondition: A survey accuracy, benchmark tie, epoch or independent collar survey becomes available
